title: C# and .NET
description: C# and .NET 10 for backend developers coming from PHP/Magento: the language and runtime, LINQ, async, ASP.NET Core APIs, EF Core and Dapper, security, testing, background work and messaging, containers, CI/CD and observability, architecture, and maintaining and migrating legacy .NET Framework code. Theory and quizzes, with practice projects to build locally.
